'''Medical Diagnostic Systems, Inc.''', also known as MeDiS, was a medical technology manufacturer located in the city of [[Tal'cara]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. During its heyday, its specialized medical hardware and software made it one of the top three corporations on Kothlis, but the company lost its footing when other operations created more advanced [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]]. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it focused on developing a new model of such [[droid/Legends|droids]].
